action.answer: The Sample Coastal District damage account for 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 is complete and independently supported as a scoped synthetic accounting exercise. Physical outcomes: 150 treatment cases and 400 lost workdays for invented worker households, both synthetic central inputs with no statistical interval and no exposure-response or causal attribution model. Financial incidence: 18,000 CU total resource financing (6,000 CU household, 12,000 CU government) plus a 2,000 CU internal firm-to-government transfer, which is identified and excluded from net damage to avoid double counting. Selected social welfare: 50,000 CU total (18,000 CU treatment at 120 CU per case; 32,000 CU productivity at 80 CU per lost workday). Mortality and direct source-fire losses are unestimated, not zero; no attributable mortality quantity or compatible unit value was supplied, and no source-fire inputs or registered empirical method exist in this MVP. Internal transfers are cancelled across the social boundary. All figures are synthetic, local-sample only, and do not establish causal attribution, health applicability, valuation transfer, legal responsibility or regional completeness.
